description: Platform-local tool schema exposed to the on-device LLM for autonomous governance routing.

tools.name: workspace_file_router
tools.description: Read/write a repo-relative file path inside the active target repository (path traversal protected). Writes require Twin approval.

tools.name: execute_isolated_task
tools.description: Execute a short python snippet inside a best-effort sandbox prelude. Requires Twin approval.

tools.name: network_data_fetch
tools.description: Fetch network data via HTTP. Disabled in default diagnostic profile.

tools.name: graphics_validate_transform_math
tools.description: Validate 3D transforms (matrix/translation/rotation/scale) and bounding boxes for NaN/Inf and divide-by-zero risk.

payload.description: JSON object or JSON string containing matrix/translation/rotation/scale/bounding_box fields.

tools.name: graphics_parse_matrix4
tools.description: Parse a 4x4 matrix (nested/flat or JSON string) into 16 finite floats.

matrix.description: 16-length array, 4x4 nested array, or JSON string.

tools.name: trace_asset_compilation
tools.description: Run a repo-pinned local asset compilation command (non-shell) and return a structured trace of warnings/errors/stdout/stderr.

asset_path.description: Repo-relative asset path being compiled/transformed (validated inside repo boundary).

compile_command.description: Command to run WITHOUT shell operators. Examples: 'npm run build', 'python scripts/build_assets.py'.
